patch.label: Quick Duel Jab
patch.description: Fast high jab with a tiny active window and long recovery after the card-hand check.

applied.reason: Standing upper-body hand check with no visible magic effect.

patch.label: Duel Disk Body Check
patch.description: Quick mid check with a short active window and weak right-side tracking.

applied.reason: Arm and Duel Disk extend through the torso line.

patch.label: Card Guard Strike
patch.description: Slow mid card-hand strike with a moderate active window after the stance shift.

applied.reason: Small guarded card motion reads as a mid poke, not a summon.

patch.label: Cross Draw Launcher
patch.description: Quick mid launcher with a long recovery window after the card draw.

applied.reason: Authored launcher with a compact crossing card-hand pose.

patch.label: Duelist Side Kick
patch.description: Steady mid kick with a tiny active window and high commitment.

applied.reason: Simple standing kick, not a magic technique.

patch.label: Low Card Feint
patch.description: Slow low feint with a moderate active window for clipping movement.

applied.reason: Arm and stance drop low enough to justify the low property.

patch.label: Low Duel Sweep
patch.description: Fast low sweep with very long active time that knocks down.

applied.reason: Low kick route is authored as knockdown and travels along the leg line.

patch.label: Trap Card Crush
patch.description: Quick mid crush with a short active hit that knocks down.

applied.reason: He steps in with a committed card-like strike and knockdown behavior.

patch.label: Crouch Card Jab
patch.description: Fast mid crouch jab with long active coverage and quick recovery.

applied.reason: Starts low and pokes forward with the card hand.

patch.label: Crouch Draw Launcher
patch.description: Steady mid launcher with a tiny active hit and heavy recovery.

applied.reason: Crouch route is authored as a launcher and points through the midline.

patch.label: Overdrive Card Flick
patch.description: Fast high card flick with long active time and almost no recovery.

applied.reason: Overdrive jab slot uses the repeated upper-body card flick.

patch.label: Millennium Aura Drive
patch.description: Slow special card drive with long active pressure that knocks down.

applied.reason: Special slot shows extended card/amulet-style poses and knockdown behavior.

patch.label: Rising Draw Check
patch.description: Fast mid while-standing check with long active time and weak right tracking.

applied.reason: While-standing route uses the same card-hand mid check.

patch.label: Rising Duel Strike
patch.description: Slow mid rising strike with steady active coverage and controlled recovery.

applied.reason: Rising route shows a forward card-hand strike at mid height.

patch.label: Downward Card Jab
patch.description: Quick high card jab with steady active time and quick recovery.

applied.reason: Down input still animates as an upper-body card-hand jab.

patch.label: Diagonal Draw Launcher
patch.description: Slow mid launcher with a tiny active hit and high whiff commitment.

applied.reason: Forward-diagonal card-hand route is authored as a launcher.

patch.label: Forward Card Check
patch.description: Slow mid forward check with a tiny active window and long recovery.

applied.reason: Advancing command uses a plain card-hand poke.

patch.label: Forward Draw Check
patch.description: Fast mid forward check with long active time and weak right tracking.

applied.reason: Forward route repeats the extended card-hand mid check.

patch.label: Quick Spell Flick
patch.description: Fast high spell-card flick with long active time and quick recovery.

applied.reason: Quarter-circle card flick is upper-body height with a casting pose.
